statement: Supply-chain sources say TSMC order visibility now extends to 2030.
why: Booked visibility four years out is a direct read on how long customers expect accelerator demand to stay above available foundry capacity.

impact.mechanism: Customers committing orders out to 2030 lock forward wafer capacity, which both confirms sustained accelerator demand and leaves little spare capacity for new entrants.

confidence.basis: Unnamed supply-chain sources in a paywalled secondary trade report; no order value or volume disclosed.
